title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 9: Aaron's first offerings on the eighth day, his blessing of the people and the fire from before Yahweh.

questions.text: On which day did Moses call Aaron, his sons and the elders of Israel?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9 begins: on the eighth day Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.

questions.text: What did Moses tell Aaron to take for a sin offering?
questions.explanation: Moses told Aaron to take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

questions.text: What were the children of Israel to take for their sin offering?
questions.explanation: The people were told to take a male goat for a sin offering.

questions.text: What reason did Moses give for bringing all these offerings that day?
questions.explanation: Moses said the offerings were to be brought, 'for today Yahweh appears to you.'

answers.text: Yahweh would appear to them that day
The people were going to leave Sinai
It was the day of the Passover

questions.text: Who brought the blood of the sin offering to Aaron?
questions.explanation: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him, and he put it on the horns of the altar.

questions.text: Which two animals were sacrificed as peace offerings for the people?
questions.explanation: Aaron killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people.

questions.text: What did Aaron wave as a wave offering before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before Yahweh, as Moses commanded.

answers.text: The breasts and the right thigh

questions.text: What did Aaron do when he lifted up his hands toward the people?
questions.explanation: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them.

answers.text: He sent them back to their tents

questions.text: What consumed the burnt offering and the fat on the altar?
questions.explanation: Fire came out from before Yahweh and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar.

answers.text: Fire lit by Aaron's sons with torches
Fire carried from Moses' own censer
Fire that came out from before Yahweh
Lightning that struck from a storm cloud

questions.text: How did the people react when they saw the fire?
questions.explanation: When all the people saw it, they shouted and fell on their faces.

answers.text: They ran away from the camp
They shouted and fell on their faces
They began to build an altar
